item.title: Understanding the Geopolitical World in One Book
item.description: Author: Wang Wei Publisher: CITIC Press Publication Year: 2017-10-15 ISBN: 9787508667751 Notes: Within ten thousand years, geography is an unchangeable fact and a field that strategists continue to study in depth. To China’s east, past Japan and across the North Pacific, lies the United States; to China’s southwest, through the Indian Ocean and the Atlantic, China is also connected to the United States.
